interval.description: Global polling interval in seconds for all monitors.

email_from.description: Sender email address for alert notifications.

email_to.description: List of recipient email addresses for alert notifications.

smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address.

smtp_user.description: SMTP username for authenticated relaying (leave blank to disable).

smtp_pass.description: SMTP password (store securely; consider external credential helpers in production).

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for SMTP connections.

name.description: Human-readable name for the monitor (e.g., 'Web Server HTTP').

comment.description: Optional comment to prepend in config (for documentation).

type.description: Monitor type — service protocol or method used.

host.description: Target hostname or IP address to probe.

port.description: TCP port to connect to (ignored for 'ping' and 'exec' types).

interval.description: Polling interval for this specific monitor (seconds).

timeout.description: Max time (seconds) to wait for a response before considering it down.

up_cmd.description: Command to execute when the monitor recovers to 'up' state (e.g., 'logger Monitor is up').

down_cmd.description: Command to execute when the monitor enters 'down' state.

alert_on_down.description: Send alert notifications when the service goes down.

monitors.description: List of services to monitor (e.g., HTTP, TCP ports, ping targets). Each item defines a monitor.

name.description: Unique name for the recipient (used by monitors to reference).

type.description: Recipient delivery type: email or command execution.

exec.description: Shell command to execute on alert (required if type = 'exec').

recipients.description: List of alert delivery endpoints. Used by monitors to send notifications.
